views.name: v_post_user
views.create_sql: CREATE VIEW v_post_user AS SELECT posts.Id AS post_id, posts.PostTypeId AS post_type_id, posts.Score AS post_score, posts.ViewCount AS view_count, posts.Title AS post_title, posts.Tags AS post_tags, posts.AnswerCount AS answer_count, posts.CommentCount AS comment_count, posts.FavoriteCount AS favorite_count, users.Id AS user_id, users.DisplayName AS author_name, users.Reputation AS author_reputation, users.Location AS author_location, users.Views AS author_views, users.UpVotes AS author_upvotes, users.DownVotes AS author_downvotes, posts.CreaionDate, posts.Body, posts.OwnerUserId, posts.LastEditorUserId, posts.ClosedDate, users.CreationDate, users.LastAccessDate, users.Age FROM posts LEFT JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id

views.name: v_comment_details
views.create_sql: CREATE VIEW v_comment_details AS SELECT comments.Id AS comment_id, comments.Score AS comment_score, comments.Text AS comment_text, comments.CreationDate AS comment_date, posts.Id AS post_id, posts.Title AS post_title, users.Id AS user_id, users.DisplayName AS commenter_name, users.Reputation AS commenter_reputation, comments.PostId, comments.UserId, posts.CreaionDate, posts.Score, posts.ViewCount, posts.Body, posts.OwnerUserId, posts.Tags, posts.AnswerCount, posts.CommentCount, posts.FavoriteCount, posts.LastEditorUserId, posts.ClosedDate, users.CreationDate, users.LastAccessDate, users.Location, users.UpVotes, users.Age FROM comments LEFT JOIN posts ON comments.PostId = posts.Id LEFT JOIN users ON comments.UserId = users.Id

views.name: v_posthistory_posts_users
views.create_sql: CREATE VIEW v_posthistory_posts_users AS SELECT postHistory.PostHistoryTypeId, postHistory.PostId, postHistory.UserId, postHistory.Text, postHistory.Comment, users.Id, users.Reputation, users.CreationDate, users.DisplayName, users.LastAccessDate, users.Location, users.UpVotes, users.Age, posts.Id AS posts_Id, posts.CreaionDate, posts.Score, posts.ViewCount, posts.Body, posts.OwnerUserId, posts.Title, posts.Tags, posts.AnswerCount, posts.CommentCount, posts.FavoriteCount, posts.LastEditorUserId, posts.ClosedDate FROM postHistory LEFT JOIN users ON postHistory.userid = users.id LEFT JOIN posts ON postHistory.postid = posts.id
